name: fixture-vault
description: Manifest for the synthetic fixture vault (Atlas and Beacon). Paths are relative to this file; source locators are relative to the vault root.

acceptance_records.rule: merged is true, merged_by is an approver, and the head revision equals the note's source_revision
state is APPROVED, the reviewer is an approver, and the reviewed commit equals the note's source_revision
the author is an approver and the body contains body_marker followed by the citing note's permalink or title

authority_policy.note: R2, owner ruling B. A note with status accepted is a decision candidate. It is an accepted decision only when the one acceptance record it cites (frontmatter acceptance_record, or a body line starting with a body label) is read serially from a repository allowlisted for that project, is a configured kind, was made by an approver, and is bound to the citing note: a pull merge or review must name the note's source_revision as its subject (a note without one cannot be promoted), an issue comment must say ACCEPTED: followed by the note's permalink or title, and a record cited by more than one note binds none of them. The default transport is offline, so every referenced record is unverified; --verifier snapshot reads fixed synthetic responses, --verifier gh reads live GitHub (optional).
